comments: REPLACE_WITH_REVIEW_COMMENTS. Please state explicitly whether the six ambiguities may remain unresolved through BDD_DESIGN, and answer AMB-ETA-351-004, AMB-ETA-351-006 and CLR-TP-ETA-351-001, which no amount of application observation can resolve.

itemDecisions.comment: Declare the kind of sign-in before entering any details. AC-ETA-351-001. Asserts that the choice exists, not how it is made.
Both sign-in kinds offered and distinguishable. AC-ETA-351-002. No Business Entity Login behaviour is exercised.
Page asks for the organization details rather than every possible field. AC-ETA-351-003. The field set is deliberately unnamed - see AMB-ETA-351-001.
Password not readable on screen. AC-ETA-351-004. Concealment only - see AMB-ETA-351-004.
Correct details reach the eCore Command Center Home page. AC-ETA-351-005. The only scenario using the real account. Stops at arrival - see AMB-ETA-351-006.
Wrong details refused and reported. AC-ETA-351-006. Fabricated data only. No message text asserted.
Missing details refused and reported. AC-ETA-351-007. Fabricated data only. Generic case only - see AMB-ETA-351-005.
The two failure responses differ from each other. AC-ETA-351-008. Performs both attempts in one scenario because the criterion is comparative.
